Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

These are some of the highest-end Cybereyes Kiroshi currently offers to regular consumers. It boasts several fashion enhancements, along with boosted optical clarity, while still providing room for upgrades.

Paired Cybereyes. They must be installed together and count as a single item for the purposes of Cost and Humanity Loss but not Critical Injuries or repair. Each Cybereye has 2 Option Slots for Cybereye Options. Each comes pre-installed with Color Shift and Image Enhance that do not cause any Humanity Loss or take up any Cybereye Option Slots.

Color Shift and Image Enhance cannot be removed without destroying the Cybereyes beyond repair. When making a Perception Check to visually notice small or obscured objects (mines, traps, turrets, hidden buttons, etc), the user gains an additional +1 bonus to their Check.

Type: Cybereye (Foundational)
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 2 Option Slots, the count for one eye; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each eye separately.
  • The pre-installed Color Shift and Image Enhance are described here rather than installed as separate items; install them from the core compendium if you want them on the sheet.
  • The +1 is situational because it only covers small or hidden objects: tick it in the roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberoptics).
